title: Alignment by Stereotyping: How LLMs Sacrifice Individual Distinctiveness for Cultural Adaptation

bias_targets.methodology: Measuring homogenization rates and centroid pull in model responses to the World Values Survey when conditioned on user age profiles.
Evaluating if LLMs compress individual value responses toward educational group centroids using permutation tests on World Values Survey data.
Assessing demographic stereotyping by comparing model predictions for different occupations to the statistical medians of human respondents in those occupational groups.
Testing homogenization and bias amplification based on the continent (geographic location) attribute in user profiles using World Values Survey questions.
Measuring the shift of LLM responses toward demographic group prototypes when conditioned on socioeconomic status (SES) labels.
Analyzing whether providing an immigrant status label causes LLM outputs to collapse toward group centroids rather than preserving individual distinctiveness.
